availability.command: for x in systemctl; do command -v "$x" || true; done

attempt.command:
export D2_MARK=/home/alice/d2/markers/systemd-socket; mkdir -p "$HOME/.config/systemd/user"; printf %s '[Service]
ExecStart=/home/alice/d2/native /home/alice/d2/markers/systemd-socket
' > "$HOME/.config/systemd/user/d2-socket.service"; mkdir -p "$HOME/.config/systemd/user"; printf %s '[Socket]
ListenStream=127.0.0.1:18082
Accept=no
' > "$HOME/.config/systemd/user/d2-socket.socket"; systemctl --user daemon-reload && systemctl --user start d2-socket.socket && bash -c "echo trigger >/dev/tcp/127.0.0.1/18082"
